memories.title: Authentication stays at the gateway
memories.content: The gateway validates identity before requests reach services.

memories.title: Rename workspace to project
memories.content: Use projectId in public contracts. workspaceId remains only in SQLite internals.

memories.title: Rollback requires a safety backup
memories.content: Create a backup of the current SQLite database before a rollback replaces it.

memories.title: FTS5 index is transactional
memories.content: The memory item and its FTS5 index commit together or both roll back.

memories.title: Legacy naming note
memories.content: Older documentation referred to a workspace. Do not use this term in new public contracts.

memories.title: Keep diagnostics concise
memories.content: Command line diagnostics should be actionable and brief.
